Try the Pizza with sea food and sea weed - delicious
Sep 2026 • Family
After being in Vietnam for almost 2 weeks and savoring Vietnamese local food, as Europeans we started missing our wood oven baked pizza. We asked our guide to recommend a good pizzeria and he suggested Italiani's. Once we entered the place we were immediately greeted by Thea who made us so welcome. We opted for the Seafood Pizza with sea weed and a Pizza with Burrata and Parma Ham. Both extremely delicious. Value for money - we really enjoyed the evening and we were very well looked after by Thea.

About the manager of the restaurant and BTM
Jun 2026 • Solo
Thank you for your instructions yesterday. I really appreciate your help. I wish there had been a simple note or guide for first-time BTM users like me when staff are not available. The machine itself is not difficult to use, but when nobody is there to assist, it can be confusing. I tried calling the phone numbers displayed on the machine, but nobody answered. My husband is overseas and had to guide me through the process. Thank you again for helping me.

I would also like to make a complaint about my experience at the restaurant where the machine is located. I understand that assisting BTM users may not be the restaurant staff’s responsibility, but the manager’s attitude toward local Vietnamese customers was very disappointing.

I noticed that he was polite and friendly to foreign customers, but he spoke loudly and rudely to me, an older Vietnamese woman. At one point, I needed assistance and could not touch his phone, yet he behaved as if I might take it. I have no reason to touch or take anyone’s phone.

What upset me most was the difference in the way he treated people. Everyone should be treated with respect regardless of nationality. Foreign customers were present and could clearly see how he was speaking to local customers. This reflects poorly on the restaurant and creates an uncomfortable atmosphere.

To be fair, his attitude improved later and he seemed to realize that he had been rude. However, the initial experience was upsetting and unnecessary. Vietnamese customers deserve the same courtesy and respect as everyone else.

I am sharing this feedback because I believe customer service should be respectful and professional for all people. Thank you for taking the time to read my concerns.

A pleasant evening at Italiani’s
Mar 2026 • Friends
My friend and I had dinner at Italiani’s (17 Yunnan) and were really happy with it!

The creamy pasta is delicious—flavored fats and pasta fiber should be very hearty and mouthwatering. The salad is round mixed, fresh and balanced, perfectly cooked.

The seafood pizza is pretty special—lush, good. The sea makes a quirky touch, but if you’re not used to it, you might smell a bit strong.

The most amazing part is the hospitality. Your Nina staff is super cute, always very helpful and helpful. This makes the meal so much more comfortable and complete.

Definitely will be back, especially because the service from Nina is amazing!
